narrative.introduction: The Nut & Seed Ontology catalogs canonical culinary nuts, edible seeds, and nut- and seed-derived ingredients used worldwide in cooking. This domain models culinary ingredients, not botanical taxonomy, snack products, confectionery, or prepared foods.
narrative.seo_description: Explore canonical culinary nuts and edible seeds by group — usage intensity, identity, and pairing metadata in the PairingMethod Food Ontology.
narrative.summary: Canonical culinary nuts and seeds across six immutable groups: Tree Nuts, Peanuts, Edible Seeds, Seed Spices, Nut Products, and Seed Products.
